// -----
// THE SERVER ROUTE for TanStack Start. Copy this file to
// src/routes/api/chat.$.ts (the $ makes it a splat route, so it
// also answers /api/chat itself) and fix the import path.
//
// It is a .txt here only so that your project does not type-check
// it before the route exists.
// -----
import { createFileRoute } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { createOpenaiChat } from "@tanstack/ai-openai";
import { HttpError, createExampleApp } from "../../vendor/chat-bot/example/wiring";

type OpenaiModel = Parameters<typeof createOpenaiChat>[0];

const app = createExampleApp({
  // How a model name becomes an adapter, and where your API key goes.
  // SAFETY: the model name comes from your own config, below.
  adapterFor: (model) => createOpenaiChat(model as OpenaiModel, process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY ?? ""),
  model: "gpt-4o-mini",
  // Must match this file's route: src/routes/api/chat.$.ts is /api/chat.
  basePath: "/api/chat",
  // Your system prompt. See the README, "Set the system prompt".
  prompts: ["You are a brief, friendly assistant."],
  // On Node the process outlives the response, so a background job just runs.
  // On Cloudflare, pass the platform's waitUntil here instead.
  waitUntil: (job) => {
    job.catch(console.error);
  },
  // WHO IS CALLING. Replace this with your real session. This demo trusts a cookie.
  ownerFrom: (request) => {
    const user = /(?:^|;\s*)user=([^;]+)/.exec(request.headers.get("cookie") ?? "")?.[1];
    if (!user) throw new HttpError("Sign in first", 401);
    return { kind: "user", scopeId: "demo", userId: decodeURIComponent(user) };
  },
});

// -----
// Start hands you a Request that `new Request(request)` cannot copy,
// so the one the app sees is built from its parts.
// -----
const executionContext = {
  waitUntil: (job: Promise<unknown>) => {
    job.catch(console.error);
  },
  passThroughOnException: () => undefined,
  props: {},
};

const handle = ({ request }: { request: Request }) => {
  const hasBody = request.method !== "GET" && request.method !== "HEAD";
  return app.fetch(
    new Request(request.url, {
      method: request.method,
      headers: request.headers,
      body: hasBody ? request.body : null,
      signal: request.signal,
      ...(hasBody ? { duplex: "half" } : {}),
    }),
    {},
    executionContext,
  );
};

export const Route = createFileRoute("/api/chat/$")({
  server: { handlers: { GET: handle, POST: handle, PATCH: handle, DELETE: handle } },
});
